## About

I am a doctoral student in Department of Supply Chain Management at Auburn University.
My research focuses on Healthcare Supply Chain and Policy Impacts on Supply Chain Networks.
<!--[One or two sentences on the big question your work addresses.]-->

<!--I am advised by [[Advisor Name]](https://advisor-page-url). My committee members include
[[Committee Member 1]](https://member1-url), [[Committee Member 2]](https://member2-url),
and [[Committee Member 3]](https://member3-url).-->

Before joining the PhD program, I worked as a Research Associate at Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (https://iima.ac.in),
where I worked on several projects related to Supply Chain Optimization, Discrete Event Simulation, Warehouse Design and EdTech Service Optimization. I also worked as a LEAN Consultant for over two years before joining IIMA for research.
